title: Spotify announces Taste Profile editing in beta, the first time it lets users fine-tune the recommendation algorithm, starting with Premium users in New Zealand (Sarah Perez/TechCrunch)
summary: Sarah Perez / TechCrunch: Spotify announces Taste Profile editing in beta, the first time it lets users fine-tune the recommendation algorithm, starting with Premium users in New Zealand — At the SXSW conference on Friday, Spotify co-CEO Gustav Söderström announced a new feature, launching in beta …
